name: .V: Valor Runs Deep
detailed_description:
Game Features:

  • Classic Side Scroll perspective with all the modern trimmings with Metroidvania Combat and traversal meeting Looter Shooter and Runner mechanics, in a unique genre mashup.

  • Custom designed, tightly tuned 2D controls: Run, gun, slash, slide, sword hop, gun hop your way through hand designed pixel art environments as you encounter deadly enemies.

  • Explore a unique post apocalyptic area of a Sci Fi world from the rich deep lore of the Sci Fi Fantasy Novel: "The World To Which They Fell" 

  • Uncover mysteries left by the book as the game explores a unique aspect of the world, as you explore destroyed parts of the land of Ozuku (one of the 10 nations from the book).

  • Your game... your style - Player Creation and Customization, with over 50 outfits, playing the game in the style you choose.

  • Weapons, Weapons, Weapons... Abounding with guns and melee weapons for you to further customize your playstyle, and advance through the game to gain more powerful and epic looking weapons as you advance through the destroyed lands of Ozuku.

  • A cast of few but interesting and creepy characters for you to meet, that lend to the telling of the destruction and the events and circumstances that followed, told by a few non hostiles that still remain in the waste and desolation.

  • Lots of enemies with varying deadliness, assume nothing, caution at all times for what might strike you in your deadly bout against the residents that now occupy this darkened place.

  • 5 Major bosses of epic proportions. Find them and defeat them to progress further into the destruction, to get ever closer to finding an answer to what happened and what enemy may be waiting for mankind.

  • Handcrafted Pixel Art landscapes in deep parallax, to create a display of depth that helps tell the story of this world and specifically these destroyed lands.

  • hand picked sounds to accompany in sound what the eyes will see in the this trial of a lone soul who is trying to find answers for humanity.

  • Complete the trials known as the 5 zones of this land of wreckage and mystery hidden in the dark, to unlock the chaos of 2 new tiers of the game in an endlessly replayable challenge.

    In the aftermath of the event that shook the world. The unexplainable appearance of giant entities crashing
    down and leaving in their wake massive areas of destruction. These destroyed lands however, hold even
    more mystery than how they occurred. One such enigma is that no one who goes to investigate ever
    returns. And in these destroyed lands technology does not function the way it normally would.

In .V - Valor Runs Deep, you are a scout, and you are asked to risk your life with almost no hope of
returning alive. Sent out to gather intel in one of these areas of destruction. Your mission; Go as deep as you can, and gather what intel you can, on what is out there in the heart of the crash site and try to find a way to send it home. From an area that not only has had no one return from it, but also where all telemetry
like wireless communication, or even radar is basically not usable.

You are entering a now place of unknown dangers, as you traverse zones within this destroyed landscape.
All to gain answers... In an experience that is brought to life from the pages of a fantasy sci fi novel. And
what awaits you is unknown, but if you can make it far enough, you might gain some answers... or even
more questions...

short_description: Enter the post apocalyptic destroyed lands from a Sci Fi Fantasy Novel. In a unique genre mashup, Metroidvania X Lootershooter. Will you uncover the truth of what lies deep in the destruction, as you slash, shoot and run your way through the decimated zones.
